REVERSE AND OVERDRIVE CLUTCH
TSB Revision
AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE OVERHAUL
23B-57
>>D<< PRESSURE PLATE/CLUTCH PLATE/CLUTCH DISC/
CLUTCH REACTION PLATE INSTALLATION
1. Install the pressure plate in the direction shown <F4A51>.
CAUTION
Immerse the clutch disc in ATF before assembling it. 
Especially if the clutch disc is new, use it only after it has 
been immersed in ATF for more than two hours.
2. Assemble the clutch discs and clutch plates, one on top of 
the other, inside the reverse clutch piston.
NUMBER OF CLUTCH DISCS AND PLATES
3. Install the clutch reaction plate in the direction shown.
>>E<< SNAP RING INSTALLATION
1. Install the snap ring into the groove in the reverse clutch 
piston.
2. Set special tools MB991628 <F4A42>, MB991629 <F4A51> 
and MD998924 as shown in the illustration, and compress 
the clutch element.
3. Check that the clearance between the snap ring and the 
clutch reaction plate is within the standard value. If not within 
the standard value, select a snap ring to adjust.
Standard value: 1.6 − 18 mm (0.0630 − 0.0709 inch)
